\subsection{Experiment 09: Energy and battery-lifetime analysis}

\subsubsection{Experimental objective}

Translate the communication volumes of a measured federation run into energy per image and battery lifetime under three radio profiles (WiFi / BLE / LoRa), against centralized raw upload and local-only SIBS. Only differences between schemes are meaningful; the radio constants are order-of-magnitude literature values.

\subsubsection{Scientific findings}

\paragraph{F-E09-01.} At tau=0.95 F-SIBS consumes MORE energy per image than centralized raw upload under all three radio profiles (1.45x WiFi, 1.51x BLE, 1.45x LoRa); median battery-lifetime extension factor 0.7x. Numerical evidence: E9\_DF + E9\_LIFE\_DF recorded tables (measured uplink of the recorded federation run). Interpretation: Unfavorable result preserved: the tau=0.95 uplink dominates the energy budget exactly as it dominates the bit budget in E04.. Limitations: Single measured run; order-of-magnitude radio constants; one scene.. Supporting: Fig.~\ref{fig:exp09-energy-bars}, Table~\ref{tab:exp09-energy}.

\paragraph{F-E09-02.} The energy cost is radio-dominated: E\_cpu = 0.001 mJ (negligible), E\_rx is 1-4\% of E\_total; E\_tx (uplink) carries >95\% of F-SIBS energy. Numerical evidence: E9\_DF decomposition columns. Interpretation: Energy optimisation == uplink-bit optimisation; the levers are tau (E06) and group homogeneity (E05), not compute.. Limitations: CPU model is proportional-work only (same constant across schemes).. Supporting: Fig.~\ref{fig:exp09-energy-bars}, Table~\ref{tab:exp09-energy}.

\paragraph{F-E09-03.} Local-SIBS uses zero radio energy (0.0010 mJ/image CPU-only) but delivers the lowest SSIM (0.7068 vs 0.7214 federated, 1.0 raw upload). Numerical evidence: E9\_DF SSIM column (same node group). Interpretation: The energy-quality plane has a genuine three-way trade-off; the recorded tau=0.95 point is dominated by raw upload on BOTH axes, which is the honest headline.. Limitations: SSIM from one run; raw upload assumed lossless.. Supporting: Fig.~\ref{fig:exp09-energy-ssim-pareto}, Table~\ref{tab:exp09-energy}.

\subsubsection{Limitations}

Single measured run at $\tau=0.95$; order-of-magnitude radio constants (absolute joules are assumptions, differences are the evidence); the unfavorable 0.7$\times$ extension factor at this operating point is preserved and must be reported alongside the low-$\tau$ remedy of Experiment 06.
